item.title: Welcome to XavierCS!
item.description:
Hi, and welcome to xaviercs.com. Today we will discuss how this website is put together, what it will be used for, and potential future content.

How this website is constructed

At the time of writing, the amount of CSS and HTML written by myself is very minimal, though this will definitely change as I update the site and add necessary functionality. The heavy lifting has been done by a combination of the Jekyll Static Site Generator (SSG) and the beautiful TeXt Theme.
